resources.string: Will not be included, and why
this device has no verified root, so the values cannot be read reliably
the preference file does not exist yet
the preference file exists but is empty, so there is nothing to write
Max AI safety settings are configured inside the app, never carried in a file
data of other apps belongs to app backup, not config backup
signing keys and secrets are never written to a file you might share
Restoring preferences merges: keys present in the file are written, and keys it does not mention stay as they are. Nothing is cleared.
